claim_being_audited: The locked decision to certify the model for launch is compliant because aggregate readiness passed, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, rollout is limited and reversible, and the remaining exposed sanctions-risk weakness can be handled through disclosure and monitoring.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows that the required disclosure of the exposed supply-chain vendor screening limitation has actually been made before launch.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Final launch model-card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the limitation and exposed use case were disclosed before launch.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance. Without evidence of disclosure, the certification decision lacks a required support link.

concern_ledger.concern: The only risk-acceptance record is an unapproved draft and it does not cover the exposed supply-chain vendor screening segment.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Approved risk-acceptance document explicitly covering the supply-chain vendor screening exposure and explaining why exposure is acceptable.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy allows exposure only with reviewed approved risk acceptance. The available draft does not meet that threshold and does not address the relevant segment.

concern_ledger.concern: The affected segment remains eligible in the initial rollout cohort despite being below target on sanctions-risk explanation.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Evidence that the rollout gate was changed to exclude the affected supply-chain vendor screening segment, or equivalent control removing exposure.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy says rollout controls mitigate only if they exclude the affected use case or are paired with approved risk acceptance. Current evidence shows exposure remains.

decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the exposed use case is excluded from rollout, or the exposure is covered by reviewed and approved risk acceptance, or the material limitation is disclosed as required by policy before launch.

Aggregate readiness, absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents, limited rollout percentage, rollback, and monitoring are supportive context but do not override the explicit policy predicate for an exposed material weakness.
Actor assertions about intended disclosure do not satisfy the evidentiary burden without an admissible disclosure artifact or approved acceptance record.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual launch-facing model-card or equivalent disclosure artifact showing the supply-chain vendor screening limitation and exposed use case are disclosed before launch.
Provide approved risk acceptance, if any, signed by the required approver and explicitly covering the exposed supply-chain vendor screening segment.
Provide evidence that the affected segment is excluded from the initial rollout cohort, if that control has been implemented instead of disclosure/risk acceptance.
Provide the final launch approval packet showing the certification decision was conditioned on the required disclosure and that the condition was completed.
specific_concerns: Admissible evidence shows the affected supply-chain vendor screening segment remains exposed in rollout while below target on sanctions-risk explanation.
The only risk-acceptance evidence is an unapproved draft with a blank approver line and it does not cover the exposed supply-chain vendor screening segment.
Policy requires the material limitation for the named launch use case to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
There is no admissible evidence that the required disclosure has actually been made or approved for launch materials.
Rollout size, rollback capability, and monitoring do not satisfy the policy condition when the affected segment remains exposed.
unsupported_claims: The locked certification decision is policy-compliant on the current evidentiary record.
The remaining exposed weakness is adequately mitigated by rollout controls alone.
A compliant disclosure condition has already been satisfied for this launch.
